You can also paste it in the setup page.

SETUP_CODE.description: At least 24 random characters, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 24`. You will type it once, on the setup page.

DATA_KEY.description: At least 32 random bytes, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`. It encrypts the secrets the Worker generates and stores (VAPID private key, device endpoints). **Keep a copy**: a lost key means re-running key generation and re-registering phones.
